name: session-retrospective
description: Evidence-based retrospective of an entire agent session, reconstructed from the harness's own session history (transcript, tool-call records, subagent logs), not from the current context. Reports what worked, what failed, where friction was, and proposes skill changes, tool fixes, and new skills or tools; every proposal is adjudicated by a critic before the user sees it. Analysis only: it changes no code, skills, configuration, or memory. Use when the user says "retrospective", "retro", "what went well / what didn't", "review the session", "lessons from this session", at the end of a substantial session, or as the close-out step of a swarm-pr-feedback drive-to-merge run before the memory closeout.
